definitions.gloss: work history; employment record; career history
definitions.explanation: A record of one's past jobs and positions. Commonly used in the context of resumes and job applications.

examples.japanese: ⟦{履歴書|りれきしょ}→履歴書：04691_rirekisho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{職歴|しょくれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I wrote my work history on my resume.

examples.japanese: {職歴|しょくれき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It's hard to find a job without work experience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{職歴|しょくれき}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しく→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦{聞|き}かれる→聞く：00483_kiku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In interviews, you are often asked in detail about your work history.

notes:
USAGE:
Primarily used in job-hunting and HR contexts. On Japanese resumes (⟦{履歴書|りれきしょ}→履歴書：04691_rirekisho⟧), there is a dedicated section for {職歴|しょくれき} where applicants list their previous employers in chronological order.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {職歴|しょくれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (write one's work history)
- {職歴|しょくれき}⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧ (work history section on a form)
- {職歴|しょくれき}なし (no work experience)
- ⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧な{職歴|しょくれき} (extensive work history)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{学歴|がくれき}→学歴：02628_gakureki⟧: educational background — the academic counterpart, often paired with {職歴|しょくれき} on resumes
- ⟦{経歴|けいれき}→経歴：13795_keireki⟧: career background — broader term covering both education and work, or general life history
- {実務経験|じつむけいけん}: practical experience — focuses on hands-on skills gained through work
